scope: Actual native driver dummies and rrtmg_lw entry arrays, captured read-only from an observer whose all seven complete 6-hour histories match the accepted executable. No engine-computed expected arrays.

radiation/operator-native-v2/HISTORY-IDE.text: All seven accepted and combined SW/LW operator-observer full histories byte-identical

logical_controls: Native logical controls are recorded as original little-endian int32 words; Python prep flags use int/bool without numerical transformation.
path_display_policy: Paths are portable artifact identifiers. Changed receipt text is labeled separately from the retained original file hash.
